text:
zara-design: posted a small prototype -> https://figma.com/file/zz/rail-consolidation. Idea: collapse similar nav items into three anchors (Models / Serve / Insights) and add inline permalinks on rows. need quick sanity check on deep-link landing behaviour and back-button UX. :eyes:
ben-ux: looks promising. main question: deep links to nested tabs (e.g. /w/:ws/models/:id?tab=versions) — should the page open parent group and snap to the item, or mount the detail view directly and keep the rail collapsed? which preserves user expectations for back nav?
liam-fe: my take: canonical nested routes (bookmarkable) but client must expand parent group then focus the detail heading. implementation: on direct load, expand without animation, scroll item into view, set focus to heading (tabindex=-1 + focus()). for SPA navigation, push history state with scrollY and openGroup so back restores list state.
anya-pm: copy alignment: let's standardize on "Models" (not Model Registry) as the primary label. breadcrumbs must be human friendly: "Acme Co • Models • MyModel" rather than raw param names. also add a tiny copy-link icon on rows so people can share exact view.
jess-a11y: accessibility checklist: 1) group headers role=button + aria-expanded value. 2) programmatic expansion must be announced via aria-live polite: e.g., "Models expanded, 4 items". 3) when deep-link lands, move focus to the detail heading so screen readers read context. 4) copy-link icon needs aria-label="Copy link to model" and visible focus styling with at least 24px target. also announce "Link copied" via aria-live when activated.
liam-fe: implementation sketch: history.pushState({scrollY: window.scrollY, openGroup: 'models', tab: 'versions'}, '', href); on popstate, restore scroll and expand state. guard for direct loads (no state) by deriving expand state from URL. tests needed for direct load vs in-app nav.
ben-ux: behavior question: if user arrives via deep link and we expand the rail, should the breadcrumb show the full humanized path immediately? yes, that helps orientation. Also consider truncation for long workspace names with tooltip containing full path via aria-label.
anya-pm: yes, breadcrumbs must have aria-label with the full expanded text for truncated visuals. permalink tooltip should read "Copy model link" per copy team.
ci-bot: route-check: found failing spec -> history-restore.spec.js for /workspaces/:ws/models sequence. CI job #4710.
zara-design: action items: 1) liam to open PR with history-state + unit tests. 2) jess to paste a11y acceptance criteria (announce strings, focus rules, aria-labels). 3) design to update Figma copy to "Models" and add inline permalinks. 4) QA to add back-button scroll restore test. i'll file GH issues and link back here. thanks! :party_parrot:
